name: tft114_st7789
title: 1.14-inch TFT on an ST7789
description: A 135x240 IPS colour display on SPI, eight contacts in a row: the backlight on a line of its own, BLK
notes: NFP114H-01BF on the ribbon of the panel. Q1 with R1 to R3 on the back switches the backlight; no regulator is seen.
The glass shows the middle of the 240x320 memory of the controller: 52 columns and 40 rows in, 53 columns from the other side when mirrored.

front.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened

back.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened and turned

photo.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13
photo.notes: GND VCC SCL SDA RES DC CS BLK beside the pins on the front, from the bottom; J1 on the back. The back has Q1, R1 to R3, C1 and C2, and no regulator.

silkscreen.source: the back: IC:ST7789V 4-SPI, 1.14"(RGB)135x240IPS, Ver:1.1; the front: 1.14"(RGB)135x240IPS. Not tried.

glass.source: the 1.14-inch 135x240 modules of other makers: LCDWiki MSP1141 User Manual Rev1.0 (www.lcdwiki.com/res/MSP1141/, sha256 01453e4a...), active area 14.86x24.91 mm; Waveshare 1.14inch LCD Module, display size 24.91 x 14.86 mm. Not measured on this one.

memory.source: dgx_panel_st7789_135x240 in src/drivers/st7789.c of DGX 0.10.16, and TFT_Drivers/ST7789_Rotation.h of TFT_eSPI: column 52 and row 40 in portrait, 53 mirrored. Not tried on a module.

levels.source: LCDWiki MSP1141 User Manual Rev1.0, a module of the same eight contacts in the same order: VCC of 3.3 V only, a transistor on the board lights the backlight on a high level of BLK. Not measured on this one.

start.source: What the ST7789 driver starts with for ST7789_RESOLUTION_135x240, not tried.
